boundaries.required_prior_attempts_action_totals_ex: Use decision_history.yield_table rows category, completed_actions, total_yield, expected_yield.status/band/unavailable_reason, attempted_uncompleted. Categories are actual tool/<name>, episode_child/<role>, job_child/<role>, child/improvement, reason, wait, etc. Saved signed marginal credit comes from own runtime_observations in completion order; inherited baseline is excluded. Show current controller expected_next_gain value/lower/upper/status_code/uncertainty_code/alpha and continuation_cost separately from category fits and duration estimates. Preserve unavailable/insufficient states. Select necessary prior attempt operands/statuses and delivered results; ask own_attempts/detail for older specific attempts. The legacy protocol has no action_yields field and cannot truthfully manufacture those category statistics from a last outcome. No child history enters the child assignment.
boundaries.original_child_task_and_typed_return_con: Original requested purpose, closed schema and interpretation meaning remain unchanged. No new fields or return composer. Parent TASK survives a child return; child TASK contains no parent yield history.
